name: Bento Grid
summary: A 6×6 bento of white tiles — one message per tile, collapsing into one hero tile on the drop.
look: Airy off-white canvas with soft teal/peach clouds, white r16 tiles with 16 px gutters, mono labels, one ink table tile and one coral anomaly tile.

components.name: Shell
components.role: 6×6 grid, radius 16, gutter 16, inner padding 28 — never changes between scenes

components.name: Anchor tile
components.role: the frame’s single message, 2–4× the area of its neighbours

components.name: Giant number tile
components.role: one mono numeral 80–130 px that counts in

components.name: Ink table tile
components.role: the only dark tile: your data, crossed by a teal scan band

components.name: Anomaly tile
components.role: coral inset border + coral −18%; slams in and nudges its neighbours

components.name: Tile-zoom seam
components.role: dive into a tile to start the next scene, or collapse the grid into one hero tile

motion.name: Tile cascade
motion.how: scale .92 → 1 + opacity, power2.out 0.4 s, 70 ms stagger large→small; big tiles on beats, small on off-beats

motion.name: Micro-motion per tile
motion.how: each tile owns one loop (count, sparkline draw, badge blink) lasting exactly 1 bar = 2 s at 120 BPM

motion.name: Grid collapse
motion.how: all tiles translate to centre + merge radii over 0.5 s expo.in, landing precisely on the drop

story: Hook: the question anchors a grid of pain tiles — 38 open tabs, 0.4% error rate, p95 212 ms and “the drop still shipped”. Reveal: the grid collapses into one hero tile with the Acme Pulse lockup. Proof: a teal scan crosses the ink metrics tile, the coral −18% Checkout conversion tile slams in with its context (since 09:42 · after deploy #2231) and a Roll back tile. CTA: a keynote-style summary bento with lockup, tagline, stats and a coral Start free tile.
adapt: Map each tile to one fact about your product (a metric, an integration, a screenshot crop) and keep a single “hero” tile per frame; the collapse/zoom seams work for any feature list.

references.note: why the bento layout took over SaaS pages
gallery of bento SaaS landing pages

fit.risk: Tiles of equal weight turn into a noisy dashboard; one anchor tile per frame.
